headlines.title: 24시간 외환시장 개방 에… 현물환 거래 10.1% 늘었다

key_headlines.title: China's Property Bubble Control Impacts Employment; South Korea Faces Similar Risk
key_headlines.summary: China's efforts to control real estate bubbles have led to employment deterioration and weakened consumer spending through reverse wealth effects. South Korea's 2026 growth target raised to 3%, but first-half employment fell short of expectations, raising concerns about a consumption decline spiral.

key_headlines.title: Trump Approves Foreign Shipbuilders to Build Two US Navy Vessels in Home Countries
key_headlines.summary: President Trump authorized foreign shipbuilders investing in the US to construct up to two US Navy vessels in their home countries, including combat ships and tankers. Korean shipyards may benefit from this new policy allowing domestic construction of US military vessels.

key_headlines.title: Trump Imposes Up to 100% Tariffs on Chinese Drones; Korea Gets 15% Rate
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration imposed maximum 100% tariffs on imported drones and components, primarily targeting Chinese market leaders like DJI. Korean drone products received preferential treatment with only 15% tariff rates applied.

key_headlines.title: US Long-term Treasury Yields Hit 25-Year High Despite Declining Inflation
key_headlines.summary: 30-year US Treasury yields reached 25-year highs despite moderating inflation, defying traditional economic patterns. The disconnect reflects concerns about sustained inflation pressures, massive government debt, and AI infrastructure investment demands.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Announces Real Estate Tax Revisions; Non-resident Single-homeowners Face Inequities
key_headlines.summary: The government proposed differential tax treatment for single-homeowners based on actual residency, triggering over 10,000 complaints from affected citizens. Non-resident single-homeowners face disadvantages, raising fairness concerns over the policy design.

sections.Hot Economy News: China's strict real estate bubble control measures have severely impacted employment and consumer spending through negative wealth effects, with South Korea potentially facing similar risks. Despite upgraded 2026 growth forecasts to 3%, first-half employment additions fell below expectations, creating concerns about potential consumption decline spirals. The Trump administration's approval for foreign shipbuilders to construct US military vessels domestically and the implementation of heavy tariffs on Chinese drones reflect intensifying trade tensions. These developments underscore broader economic challenges including employment deterioration, consumption weakness, and protectionist trade policies affecting both Korea and global markets.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Korean government reported strengthened economic recovery momentum driven by robust exports, with July employment gains increasing by 108,000 year-over-year. However, employment challenges persist as the unemployment rate rose 0.2 percentage points to 2.6%, and core inflation excluding food and energy increased to 2.6% from 2.5% the previous month. Consumer price inflation moderated to 2.8% in July from 3.2% in June, though personal services inflation accelerated from 3.4% to 3.5%. Global economic conditions show continued moderate growth, though risks from Middle Eastern tensions and US tariff policies create ongoing uncertainty. The government acknowledges that while growth momentum strengthens, inflation and employment pressures continue burdening household finances.
sections.Financial Markets: US long-term Treasury yields have reached 25-year highs despite moderating inflation, defying conventional economic relationships and creating market confusion. The 30-year Treasury yield surge reflects persistent inflation concerns, massive federal debt accumulation exceeding GDP, and heavy capital demands from AI infrastructure investments by major tech companies and data centers. Federal debt now surpasses quarterly GDP figures, with Congressional Budget Office projections showing the debt-to-GDP ratio will exceed post-World War II peak levels of 106% by 2030. The divergence between declining inflation and rising yields suggests underlying structural concerns about debt sustainability and long-term growth prospects. Meanwhile, stock markets have retreated from recent highs as investors shift focus from inflation concerns to economic growth worries.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor and energy sectors are preparing for massive power demand increases from the Honam semiconductor industrial complex and AI data centers, prompting government reforecasting of future electricity needs. SK Innovation partnered with TerraPower on small modular reactors (SMR) to support AI data center power requirements, leveraging existing LNG capabilities. The collaboration integrates SK Hynix AI semiconductors, SK Telecom's data center infrastructure, SK Innovation's LNG and SMR capabilities, and SK Battery's energy storage solutions. Lamborghini shifted strategy from pure electric to plug-in hybrid vehicles given market realities, with the CEO emphasizing PHEV as a permanent solution rather than transitional technology. A steel storage yard fire in Wonju consumed scrap metal and batteries, though no casualties occurred.
sections.Real Estate: The government announced new housing supply and financing measures including expanded relocation loan coverage and incentives for early construction starts in redevelopment and reconstruction projects. Relocation loans currently capped at 40% of property value create hardships for residents, particularly when jeonse prices surge, prompting demands for expanded lending limits. High-value apartment transactions surged in April-May before July's implementation of enhanced capital gains taxes on multi-property owners, with transactions over 3 billion won reaching nearly 6%. The government plans to consider expanding housing development across the entire Yongsan Park beyond the children's garden portion, with the Ministry of Land Infrastructure noting the provincial government cannot block development if special legislation passes. Property sector policies aim to revitalize reconstruction projects while addressing affordability concerns.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration imposed maximum 100% tariffs on drones and components, targeting Chinese manufacturers like DJI that dominate global markets, while applying preferential 15% rates to Korean products. The US simultaneously approved foreign shipbuilders investing in America to construct up to two Navy vessels domestically, potentially benefiting Korean shipyards including Hanwha Philsa in Philadelphia. Trump administration officials reportedly pressured Apple to avoid purchasing Chinese memory semiconductors, citing national security concerns. The US Federal Reserve's upcoming FOMC minutes release, expected Thursday at 3 AM Korea time, will be closely watched for signals on future rate decisions as traders assess 67% probability of unchanged rates in September. South Korean trade negotiators face pressure to address tariff issues amid intensifying US trade protectionism.
sections.AI & Economy: The Korean government is recalculating electricity demand forecasts to account for three major megaprojects: the Honam semiconductor industrial complex, the Yonggin semiconductor complex, and AI data centers, with estimated additional power needs potentially reaching 50GW. These megaprojects represent confirmed electricity demand increases requiring comprehensive power supply infrastructure planning and potential grid expansion. The government resumed formal discussions through electricity basic plan forums to integrate AI data center requirements into long-term energy strategy. SK Innovation's partnership with TerraPower on small modular reactors directly targets powering AI data center operations with reliable baseload capacity. These developments underscore growing recognition that AI infrastructure deployment represents a structural shift in national energy demand requiring proactive policy responses.
sections.Others: Apple, Nike, and approximately 40 US companies received windfall refunds totaling 9.6 billion dollars following the US Supreme Court's ruling on tariff constitutionality, with Apple alone receiving 2.1 billion dollars in refunds. The US trade representative confirmed support for foreign shipbuilders with American investment to construct up to two Navy vessels in home countries, creating opportunities for Korean shipyard operators. Daejeon's Startup Park has emerged as Korea's Silicon Valley equivalent, with 255 employees and companies that have graduated to NASDAQ listings, boosting local restaurant businesses. South Korea's head of trade negotiations was dismissed during intensifying US trade pressure, complicating negotiations over tariffs and non-tariff barriers. The US and China exchanged cooperation gestures around Liberation Day, while Japan's government confirmed Yasukuni Shrine visits, reflecting differing regional diplomatic approaches.
